notes: Homepage meta: 'Shop Mac Duggal luxury evening gowns, cocktail dresses, prom dresses, mother of the bride, and wedding guest styles in regular, petite, and plus sizes.' The Brand page: 'one of the most sought-after names in women's luxury apparel and evening wear'; mentions 'our hand-beaded dresses'; Creative Director Ieena Duggal runs the line 'Ieena for Mac Duggal'; founder Mac Duggal born 1960 in New Delhi; the brand is 'largely found in boutiques and department stores'. Founding year and production location not stated on the site.
HQ: homepage Organization JSON-LD and meta.json give 145 Tower Drive, Suite 1, Burr Ridge, Illinois 60527, US.

Shipping (pages/shipping, policies/shipping-policy): free standard ground on US orders (contiguous US only, 3–7 business days), Express $25; site banner 'Free Express Shipping Over $300 USD'. International: Premium Standard $15 (free over $300) or DHL Express $25; pages/international: 'worldwide shipping to most countries' via Global-e, duties prepayable at checkout. Country selector lists US, CA, GB, AU (FAQ: if your flag isn't listed it probably doesn't ship there).

Returns (pages/returns-exchanges): return or exchange within 14 days of delivery; refund to original payment or store credit; $20 return label fee deducted unless the $7.98 'free return' option is bought at checkout; 'Final Sale' items not returnable.
Sizes: size chart 0 (XS) to 30 (bust 60in, waist 54in); petite chart linked. Regular dresses carry US 0–30 and petite US 0P–18P in the feed (US 26–30 on a few styles only).
Store locator (Stockist widget) did not load for WebFetch; no Mac Duggal-owned US store confirmed, so us_stores left empty.
